cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Steer the Suspicion
cards.instruction: Hide your responsibility by redirecting every new clue toward a safer explanation before anyone can connect it back to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get the claim started. That ink on your new sofa must be from the delivery label.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The label's dry. You signed with your fountain pen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they brushed my signature against it. I'll hold the cushion while you photograph the mark.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your pen's still leaking onto it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll take it off. Photograph the pen too; they must have cracked it squeezing past me.

reason: A now helps with photographs and stops the active leak while each supplied clue becomes a new carrier-blame theory; practical cooperation replaces rank assertions.
